finalists.label: Netherton syndrome
finalists.why: It has specific evidence from trichography and eyebrow hair characteristics that are unique to this condition.

finalists.label: alopecia
finalists.why: It is supported by specific findings of sparse and short eyebrow hairs and coarse scalp hairs.

finalists.label: Alopecia Areata
finalists.why: It is supported by specific findings of sparse eyebrow hairs and trichography results showing nodal swelling.

frontier_selector.why: Netherton syndrome is chosen because it accounts for both skin and hair findings, including the specific trichography results and eyebrow hair characteristics, making it a more comprehensive diagnosis.
